_about: Final committee orders from the verified CFP release tables in the lake (the last release of each season); each team's conference is its membership on 1 December; champions are the winners of the title games listed in data/title_games.csv. Top fours, the 2024 and 2025 top 25s and seeds were checked against collegefootballplayoff.com on 25 Nov 2026; champions were checked against a secondary source only.
